func typechecker_strip_module_prefix(name: str, ctx: &Arena) str {
    mut d_idx := std.str_find(name, "__");
    if d_idx != 0 - 1 {
        mut s_idx := std.str_find(name, "_");
        if s_idx == d_idx {
            return std.str_slice(name, d_idx + 2, len(name));
        }
    }
    return name;
}
